issues.title: Fields have no visible labels
issues.detail: The email, card number, expiry and CVC fields show their name only as placeholder text. It disappears as soon as someone starts typing, so people lose track of what each field wants.
issues.fix: Add a visible label above each field. Keep the placeholder only for an example, or drop it.

issues.title: "We send your receipt to this address" is too faint
issues.detail: "We send your receipt to this address" measures 1.85 : 1 on #FFFFFF. Text needs at least 4.5 : 1.
issues.fix: Use #70767E for this text: it measures 4.58 : 1 on #FFFFFF.

issues.title: Five payment options compete
issues.detail: Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna get the same weight. Most people pay by card, but everyone has to scan five choices before they can start.
issues.fix: Show the two or three most used methods and put the rest behind "Other methods".

issues.title: "Terms" is too small to tap
issues.detail: 11 px tall. Targets need at least 24 by 24 px.
issues.fix: Make it at least 24 px tall, ideally 44 px.

issues.title: Five payment options compete
issues.detail: Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna still get the same weight, so everyone scans five choices before paying.
issues.fix: Show the two or three most used methods and put the rest behind "Other methods".

issues.title: Card number error is shown only in red
issues.detail: The card number field turns red, but nothing says what is wrong. People who do not see red well get no signal at all, and nobody learns how to fix it.
issues.fix: Add a message under the field that says what is wrong and how to fix it, with an error icon.

issues.title: Error message does not say how to fix it
issues.detail: "Invalid input" under the email field says that something is wrong, but not what. The address is missing its domain ending, and the message could say exactly that.
issues.fix: Say what to change, for example "Add the end of the address, like sam@example.com".

issues.title: Password field has no visible label
issues.detail: The password field only has placeholder text. Once someone types, nothing on screen says what the field is for.
issues.fix: Add a visible "Password" label above the field, like the other fields.

issues.title: Password rules are not shown
issues.detail: Nothing tells people how long the password must be or which characters it needs, so many will only find out from an error after they submit.
issues.fix: Show the rules under the field before people type, and tick them off as they are met.

issues.title: "I agree to the terms and privacy policy" is too small to tap
issues.detail: 13 px tall. Targets need at least 24 by 24 px.
issues.fix: Make it at least 24 px tall, ideally 44 px.

issues.title: Two primary buttons compete
issues.detail: "Create account" and "Sign up with Google" are both filled blue buttons of the same size, so neither reads as the main action.
issues.fix: Keep "Create account" as the primary button and make the Google option an outlined secondary button.

issues.title: Page title looks like body text
issues.detail: "Sales overview" has the same size and weight as body text, while the numbers below are far larger. At a glance people cannot tell which page they are on.
issues.fix: Make "Sales overview" a real heading, clearly larger and bolder than the content.

issues.title: Nine equal buttons, nothing stands out
issues.detail: Export, Share, Filter, Refresh, Compare, Annotate, Schedule, Settings and Print all look the same, so the common actions are as hard to find as the rare ones.
issues.fix: Keep the two or three most used actions visible, make the main one stand out, and move the rest into a "More" menu.

issues.title: KPI labels sit far from their numbers
issues.detail: Each label, such as Revenue or Orders, is at the bottom of its card, far from the number it names. People read a number before they know what it means.
issues.fix: Put each label right above its number and keep the change next to it.

issues.title: Up and down are shown only by colour
issues.detail: The change under each number is green or red, with no plus or minus sign and no arrow. People who do not see colour well cannot tell growth from decline.
issues.fix: Add an arrow or a plus or minus sign to each change, and write "up" or "down" for screen readers.

issues.title: Text is too faint
issues.detail: This text measures 3.10 : 1 on #FFFFFF. Text needs at least 4.5 : 1. Bold text from about 19 px only needs 3 : 1, but bold is not detected.
issues.fix: Use #6D7585 for this text: it measures 4.63 : 1 on #FFFFFF.

issues.title: Body text is small
issues.detail: About 13 px. My checklist asks for at least 16 px. Estimated from the text line height.
issues.fix: Use at least 16 px for body text.
